component.name: Spinner for Discogs
component.summary: Browse your Discogs vinyl collection and control music playback

description.p: Spinner for Discogs is an unofficial third-party desktop client for Discogs. Connect your Discogs account to browse your vinyl collection, spin a random record, and control Spotify or YouTube Music playback — all from one app.

ul.li: Browse and search your Discogs collection and wantlist
Spin the wheel to pick a random album to play
Control Spotify playback directly from the app
View release details, tracklists, and market prices
Sync your collection in the background with progress feedback

description.p: A free Discogs Personal Access Token is required. Optional Spotify integration requires a Spotify account and internet connection.
First public installer release for Linux, Windows, and macOS. Native cross-platform installers for all major desktop operating systems.
